## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes (lint, types, tests with coverage, build, docs)
- [ ] Tests cover what the change promises
- [ ] A user-facing change updates `docs/`, and `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased if the commit subject cannot say it all
- [ ] The commit messages follow Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, …)
